capabilities: Switch a note's type via a dropdown in the Properties editor
Populate properties and content from the selected type's template
Apply a default note type automatically to new or empty files
Move a note to a folder configured for its type
Render templates with built-in {{ variable }} syntax or Templater
disambiguation: Not an automatic note classifier; types are set manually via a dropdown and template application.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to assign a typed identity to notes and populate frontmatter and body from a type-specific template in one step.

relations.evidence: More complex templates can be implemented using the Templater plugin
This plugin is heavily inspired by the latest update of Octarine (v0.42)

summary: Note type manager that adds a dropdown in the Properties editor to switch a note's type and apply the matching template to properties and content.
